title: Nx Monorepo Setup
description: Align npm workspaces with Nx projects, tighten nx.json, standardize project metadata, validate graph and targets.
summary: Normalized npm workspaces (removed compose/studio, added compose/store and assets/images), tightened nx.json (defaultBase, namedInputs, workspaceLayout, targetDefaults with production inputs for build), aligned root/VS Code Nx project ids to package names, fixed package.json metadata and repository directories, and repaired compose/js strict TypeScript (GraphQL helpers, kitGraphqlJsonToReadonlyArray, isJsonObjectNode, VCS batch casts, KitColoredConnectorRowDto). Validation: npm install, npx nx show projects, npx nx build compose/graphql, npx nx run-many -t build -p @semio-tech/compose-js @semio-tech/repo-client @repo/server @elements/ui, npx nx test @semio-tech/compose-js.
